units.source_text: 这是对朱雀院表示谦逊之意。

en.t: This was meant as a gesture of humility toward the Suzaku Cloistered Emperor.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝今年二十一岁，相貌越长越美，竟与源氏毫无两样。

en.t: Emperor Reizei was twenty-one years old that year, and as he grew older his looks became ever more beautiful, until he was utterly indistinguishable from Genji.

units.source_text: 中纳言夕雾侍候在侧，其相貌又与冷泉帝无异，令人惊讶。

en.t: The Middle Counselor Yugiri attended at his side, and his appearance too was no different from Emperor Reizei's, which was astonishing to behold.

units.source_text: 由于地位不同之故，夕雾在气度上似乎不及冷泉帝之高贵，但其风流艳冶之相，则胜于冷泉帝。

en.t: Because their ranks were different, Yugiri seemed not to match Emperor Reizei in noble bearing, but in elegant and alluring beauty he surpassed the emperor.

units.source_text: 夕雾吹笛，音节异常悦耳。

en.t: When Yugiri played the flute, its notes were extraordinarily pleasing to the ear.

units.source_text: 诸殿上人在阶下唱歌，就中弁少将嗓音最美。

en.t: The courtiers sang below the steps, and among them the Minor Captain Ben had the most beautiful voice.

units.source_text: 戚族并皆英俊，真乃宿世福报。

en.t: All the members of the family were handsome and gifted; it was truly a blessing earned in former lives.
